digest.component_or_area: Claude Code agent MCP tool configuration
propositions: Serena symbol tools are deferred by default, requiring an extra ToolSearch round-trip before use, creating friction compared to non-deferred tools like Bash/grep
ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH is the only available control for deferral and is all-or-nothing (no per-tool or per-server granularity), making the <=4-tool limitation unimplementable
Loading all Serena schemas to make symbol tools resident costs a minimum of 25k additional tokens, scaling to 64k with multiple connected MCP servers
A tracked .claude/settings.json with ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH=false will un-defer symbol tools repo-wide, but the cost-benefit tradeoff must be measured and documented
The solution requires .gitignore negation to track .claude/settings.json while keeping the rest of .claude/ ignored, and must include revert documentation
